question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ***Dimension*** is the most appropriate word to fill in blank number 3.
 
• The sentence implies that the old artist provides a new perspective or facet (dimension) to the common theme of sympathy and sacrifice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Supervision**: Incorrect because it implies overseeing or managing something, which is unrelated to the context.
 
• **Condition**: Incorrect because it refers to a state or situation, which doesn’t fit the sentence’s intent.
 
• **Infection**: Incorrect because it refers to disease transmission and is completely irrelevant in this context.
